info.title: Matomo Reporting API for SitesManager plugin

get.description: Returns the JavaScript tracking tag for the given website.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to generate tracking code for.

parameters.name: piwikUrl
parameters.description: The domain and URL path to the Matomo installation. Defaults to the current Matomo URL.

parameters.name: mergeSubdomains
parameters.description: Whether to track visitors across all subdomains of the site.

parameters.name: groupPageTitlesByDomain
parameters.description: Whether to prepend the site domain to the page title when tracking.

parameters.name: mergeAliasUrls
parameters.description: Whether to treat alias URLs as part of the same website for outlink detection.

parameters.name: visitorCustomVariables
parameters.description: Custom visitor-scope variables as `array(array('name', 'value'), ...)`.

parameters.name: pageCustomVariables
parameters.description: Custom page-scope variables as `array(array('name', 'value'), ...)`.

parameters.name: customCampaignNameQueryParam
parameters.description: Custom campaign name query parameter name, overriding the default.

parameters.name: customCampaignKeywordParam
parameters.description: Custom campaign keyword query parameter name, overriding the default.

parameters.name: doNotTrack
parameters.description: Whether to respect the browser's Do-Not-Track setting.

parameters.name: disableCookies
parameters.description: Whether to disable all first-party cookies.

parameters.name: trackNoScript
parameters.description: Whether to include a `<noscript>` image-based fallback for JavaScript-disabled browsers.

parameters.name: crossDomain
parameters.description: Whether to enable cross-domain linking.

parameters.name: forceMatomoEndpoint
parameters.description: Whether the Matomo endpoint should be forced if Matomo was installed prior to 3.7.0.

parameters.name: excludedQueryParams
parameters.description: Array or comma-separated string of query parameters to exclude from page URLs.

parameters.name: excludedReferrers
parameters.description: Array or comma-separated string of referrer hosts/URLs to ignore.

parameters.name: disableCampaignParameters
parameters.description: Whether to prevent campaign parameters from being sent to the tracker.

200.description:
The JavaScript tag ready to be included in HTML pages.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns image link tracking code for a given site with specified options.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The ID to generate tracking code for.

parameters.name: piwikUrl
parameters.description: The domain and URL path to the Matomo installation.

parameters.name: actionName
parameters.description: Action name to include in the image tracking request, or `false` to omit it.

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: Goal ID to trigger a conversion for, or `false` to omit goal tracking.

parameters.name: revenue
parameters.description: Revenue for the goal conversion. Only used when `$idGoal` is supplied.

parameters.name: forceMatomoEndpoint
parameters.description: Whether the Matomo endpoint should be forced if Matomo was installed prior to 3.7.0.

200.description:
The HTML-encoded image tracking code.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Add a website.

parameters.name: siteName
parameters.description: Site name.

parameters.name: urls
parameters.description: The URLs array must contain at least one URL called the 'main_url'; if several URLs are provided in the array, they will be recorded as alias URLs for this website. When calling the API via HTTP specify multiple URLs via `&urls[]=http...&urls[]=http...`.

parameters.name: ecommerce
parameters.description: Whether Ecommerce Reporting is enabled (1) or disabled (0).

parameters.name: siteSearch
parameters.description: Whether Site Search is enabled (1) or disabled (0).

parameters.name: searchKeywordParameters
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of search keyword parameter names.

parameters.name: searchCategoryParameters
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of search category parameter names.

parameters.name: excludedIps
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of IPs to exclude from reports (allows wildcards).

parameters.name: excludedQueryParameters
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of URL query parameters to strip from tracked URLs.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Timezone string, e.g. `'Europe/London'`. Defaults to the global default timezone.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code, e.g. `'EUR'`. Defaults to the global default currency.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Website group identifier. Requires Superuser access.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Date at which statistics for this website will start, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Defaults to today's date.

parameters.name: excludedUserAgents
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of user agent substrings to exclude.

parameters.name: keepURLFragments
parameters.description: If `1`, URL fragments will be kept when tracking. If `2`, they will be removed. If `0`, the default global behavior will be used.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The website type, defaults to `'website'` if not set.

parameters.name: settingValues
parameters.description: Measurable settings keyed by plugin name, each containing an array of `['name' => string, 'value' => mixed]` pairs.

parameters.name: excludeUnknownUrls
parameters.description: Whether to track only URLs matching one of the website's registered URLs.

parameters.name: excludedReferrers
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hosts/URLs to exclude from referrer detection.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional description providing additional context about this site, such as its purpose or usage.

200.description:
The ID of the newly created website.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

tags.name: SitesManager
tags.description: The SitesManager API gives you full control on Websites in Matomo (create, update and delete), and many methods to retrieve websites based on various attributes. This API lets you create websites via "addSite", update existing websites via "updateSite" and delete websites via "deleteSite". When creating websites, it can be useful to access internal codes used by Matomo for currencies via "getCurrencyList", or timezones via "getTimezonesList". There are also many ways to request a list of websites: from the website ID via "getSiteFromId" or the site URL via "getSitesIdFromSiteUrl". Often, the most useful technique is to list all websites that are known to a current user, based on the token_auth, via "getSitesWithAdminAccess", "getSitesWithViewAccess" or "getSitesWithAtLeastViewAccess" (which returns both). Some methods will affect all websites globally: "setGlobalExcludedIps" will set the list of IPs to be excluded on all websites, "setGlobalExcludedQueryParameters" will set the list of URL parameters to remove from URLs for all websites. The existing values can be fetched via "getExcludedIpsGlobal" and "getExcludedQueryParametersGlobal". See also the documentation about Managing Websites in Matomo.
